item.title: Freedonia earthquake: more than 100 killed as rescue teams search rubble
item.description: A magnitude 7.2 earthquake struck the coast of Freedonia early on Sunday. Officials said at least 120 people were killed and hundreds are missing. Rescue teams are searching collapsed buildings in the port city of Alderport.

item.title: Central bank cuts interest rates by quarter point
item.description: The Federal Reserve lowered its benchmark rate by 0.25 percentage points on Saturday, citing a cooling labour market. Inflation remains above target.

item.title: Cloud provider outage disrupts thousands of websites
item.description: A major cloud provider suffered a multi-hour outage affecting banking apps and retailers. The company said it was investigating the cause.

item.title: WHO reports measles outbreak spreading across three regions
item.description: The World Health Organization said 4,200 cases of measles were confirmed this month and urged vaccination campaigns.

item.title: Champions League final: City beat Inter 2-1 in extra time
item.description: Manchester City won the Champions League final 2-1 after extra time in Istanbul.
